title: Associations of Environmental, Waterway-Context, and Human-Activity Predictors with Blackchin Tilapia Records in Thailand
description: Versioned code, model-ready inputs permitted for redistribution, archived out-of-fold predictions, spatial diagnostics, and figures for an exploratory presence-background analysis of blackchin tilapia records in Thailand. The unpublished manuscript is not included. Screening surfaces are not occurrence probabilities or operational risk maps.
